preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each test case must have a sequence length n between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a must be an integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the weights of all subsegments of the sequence a.
